newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Tower Automotive, Pediatrix options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Tower Automotive, Pediatrix options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Friday it would list options on Tower Automotive Inc and Pediatrix Medical Group Inc on May 1.

The exchange said Tower Automotive options would open with strike prices of 30, 35 and 40, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. Initial expirations have been set for May, June, August and November.
Group One Trading LP has been named the specialist unit for the options, the AMEX said.
Pediatrix options would have opening strike prices of 25, 30 and 35. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
The options would have initial expirations in May, June, August and November.
The AMEX said Spear, Leeds & Kellogg has been named the specialist unit for Pediatrix options.
